entities.summary: Frédéric André Jousset is a French entrepreneur, philanthropist and racing driver. He co-founded Webhelp in 2000 and sold it to Concentrix in 2023 on a $4.8 billion valuation. Patron of the arts, he created the foundation Art Explora and its investing arm ArtNova in 2019 and runs the Compagnie Financière Jousset (CFJ) which finances companies in the industrial, technology or service industry.
